hero.title: Beautiful invitations for every Sri Lankan celebration
hero.subtitle: Create a lovely event page for your wedding, homecoming, big girl party, birthday or dana – and share it on WhatsApp in minutes. In සිංහල, தமிழ் and English.

steps.d: Add the names, date, venue, nekath times and photos. It takes about five minutes.
Choose a template that suits your occasion and see it come to life as you type.
Get your own link like /e/nimal-weds-sachini and send personal invitations to every family.

templates.title: Designs for every occasion
templates.subtitle: Tap any design to see a live example.

items.d: Guests can read your invitation in Sinhala, Tamil or English with one tap.
Built for slow data and older phones. Large, easy-to-read text for elders.
Greet each family by name and know how many are coming.
See who is attending, meal choices and total headcount. Read heartfelt wishes.
Show every ceremony with its auspicious time and a live countdown.
One-tap directions in Google Maps and a preview card that looks great in WhatsApp.

pricing.title: Simple pricing
pricing.subtitle: Placeholder prices – payments are coming soon. Everything is free while we launch.

items.q: Do my guests need an account?
items.a: No. Guests just open your link, read the invitation and reply. Nothing to install.

items.q: Will it work on slow internet?
items.a: Yes. Pages are small, photos are compressed and fonts load only for the language in use.

items.q: Can I write in Sinhala and Tamil?
items.a: Yes. Write your text in any language and optionally add translations. Guests choose their language.

items.q: Can I make the page private?
items.a: Yes. Hide it from search engines, or protect it with a password on paid plans.

items.q: How do I send personal invitations?
items.a: Add your guest list, then tap Send on WhatsApp next to each name. Each person gets a link that greets them.

footer.tagline: Invitations made with love for Sri Lankan families.
